Retaining Ring · E-Type

E-Type Retaining Ring (E-Ring)

A retaining ring fitted into a narrow groove machined on a shaft, in the radial direction (perpendicular to the shaft). Unlike the C-type, it can be pressed into place by hand or with a simple jig without a dedicated plier, so it is widely used for securing small, low-cost parts. The spec code is designated as ETW, and it conforms to the KS B 1337 and JIS B 2805 standards.
